chapters.title: Concerning the Three Vessels
chapters.note: The oldest teaching layer is strongly dominant. The chapter teaches the cosmic process of three-vessel discharge through two extended correspondential analogies (doctor/healing and mother/birth with body-layer enumeration) and a systematic twelve-deed enumeration. The analogies are structurally rich: the birth analogy maps seven body-layers (marrow, bones, tendons, flesh, veins, blood, skin) doubled through mother+child to eighteen garments — classic body-cosmos correspondence. The twelve deeds (¶14-32) are compact substrate enumeration of cosmic advantages. Editorial overlay is light: dialogue frame in ¶1-2 and ¶13, counterfactual contemporary applications in ¶16-20 (with 'today' anchors and one institutional reference to fasting in ¶19), and a closing self-reference in ¶33. The negative editorial fatigue score (-0.79) confirms the second half is cleaner than the first. Teaching purity 0.670. The seam flags on ¶17-18 are likely false positives — the bridge connectives continue a three-fold iteration (one per vessel) rather than extending to institutional content.
